LESSON: ADHESIVES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: WOODWORK
Strand: Materials 2.2 Timber conversion and seasoning (14 lessons) By the end of the sub
Topic 2.3: Adhesives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Adhesives, part of Materials 2.2 Timber conversion and seasoning (14 lessons) By the end of the sub in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 WOODWORK.

Key inquiry question: Why are wood adhesives important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify types of adhesives used for bonding materials,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. describe the characteristics of adhesives used in Woodwork,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. use adhesives to bond materials in Woodwork.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the importance and use of wood adhesives.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Adhesives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

A. identify types of adhesives used for bonding materials,

D. appreciate the importance and use of wood adhesives.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Adhesives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and teamwork skills when discussing types of

adhesives used in bonding materials.

● Learning to learn: learner reflects on own work when visiting nearby workshops to observe uses of adhesives used in

Woodwork.

● Digital literacy: learner develops digital skills when interacting and manipulating digital devices to search online the

characteristics of adhesives used in Woodwork.

Values:
● Responsibility: learner takes care of adhesives when applying on a surface to avoid wastage.

● Unity: learners work together in groups to discuss types of adhesives used in bonding materials and classification of

adhesives.

22

● Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions of others as learner discusses safety precautions related to use and disposal

of adhesives.

23

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Drug and substance abuse: learner prepares and applies adhesives on a surface.

● Environmental conservation: learner manage the use and disposal of adhesive wastes

suggested learning resources: adhesives, video clips, pictures, realias,

2. describe the characteristics of adhesives used in Woodwork,
3. use adhesives to bond materials in Woodwork.
4. appreciate the importance and use of wood adhesives.
